verdict.rationale: Rootly documents its own iOS and Android mobile app for on-call. The app offers an Incident Summary card and the Rootly AI agent, and pricing lists mobile shift swaps and overrides. However, no evidence shows the specific acknowledge, escalate, and resolve actions in the app; those are documented only for Microsoft Teams, which does not transfer here. Missing for 10: documented in-app acknowledge/escalate/resolve actions, mobile push-paging details, independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
